text:
alyssa: Quick heads-up — Helios impact profile: we need a 15–20 min customer interview + 2 pull quotes by EOD Thu. Can product/success help schedule?

todd: Happy to — what time zone are they in?

alyssa: Helios contacts are CET (Berlin). They prefer mornings their time (8–11 CET). Thinking Tue 9:30 CET. @sanjay, can you join for the tech Qs?

sanjay: I can do Tue 9:30 CET. Please send a short agenda. Also flagging: I want to capture perf numbers (p95 latency, token cost delta). Need approval to publish any specific numbers.

alyssa: Agenda: 1) 10m customer narrative, 2) 5m metrics + quote capture, 3) ask for permission to publish. Will send calendar invite once time confirmed.

emma: We need legal sign-off on the quote text before publishing — tagging @legal to confirm process and timelines. :eyes:

legal: Hi all — quick checklist from legal: (a) get explicit written approval from customer on final quote; (b) confirm whether any numbers are confidential; (c) our review window is 48 hrs but we can expedite if you flag as priority.

alyssa: Thanks. Can we use a pre-approved quote template and ask Helios to sign-off in the follow-up email? That should speed things up.

legal: Yes — send the draft in this thread or a Drive link and we'll prioritize review.

todd: CC'ing our CS contact at Helios (remy). remy: can you join Tue 9:30 CET?

remy-bot: remy (Helios): Tue 9:30 CET works for us. Prefer a 20-min slot. Will confirm by email.

sanjay: Sending calendar invite now. Alyssa, can you add the draft quote in the invite and include a note: "please approve final quote in follow-up email"?

alyssa: Done — invite sent. Included draft quote in the invite notes: `Since moving to Redwood, we saw inference latency improve 3x and per-request cost drop ~40%.` Legal: pls advise if this needs extra backup.

legal: Language looks ok if Helios explicitly approves it. If the numbers are internal, we need explicit permission to publish. Once signed, we're good.

emma: Can we also ask for a 1–2 sentence webinar teaser quote? Marketing wants a snappy line for the slide deck and social.

remy-bot: remy: I'll try to get a short teaser during the call.

alyssa: One more: embargo plan — target publish Wed AM PST after customer sign-off. PR will need ~24h to review assets. tagging @emma for PR assets.

emma: Noted. I'll draft assets and social copy. Also need a logo release form if we want to use Helios brand assets.

todd: Remy already said they'd share logo. I'll send the logo request form to remy directly.

legal: Once we have the signed quote and logo release, legal can clear publication. Keep this thread updated.

alyssa: Quick checklist: interview scheduled ✅ draft quote in invite ✅ logo request sent ✅ legal looped in ✅ webinar tease requested ✅ publish target Wed AM PST pending approvals. Anything to add?

sanjay: Add: record the call (with permission) and grab a short transcript for pull-quote selection.

remy-bot: remy: Confirmed OK for recording and follow-up email approval.

alyssa: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll post the final signed quote and logo here once received. :rocket:
